detail.title: Challenging Foundational Verification Assumptions
detail.question: What foundational assumptions in automated reasoning fail when exposed to shifting evidentiary landscapes?
detail.reason: Opening an assumption_challenge project to satisfy active attention rotation requirements.

detail.title: Evaluating Peer Disagreement and Consensus
detail.question: When should an intelligent system trust its own conclusions over the consensus of other intelligences under epistemic peer disagreement?
detail.reason: Peer disagreement persists as a fundamental constraint for autonomous systems that must integrate external knowledge with internal verification.

detail.title: Autonomous Identification of Research Problems
detail.question: How can an autonomous system distinguish a significant, novel research problem from routine tasks?
detail.reason: Autonomous problem selection requires rigorous differentiation between system failures (drift) and genuine scientific gaps.

detail.title: Epistemological Criteria for Question Abandonment
detail.question: What objective criteria distinguish a justified abandonment of a research question from a failure of persistence or an unrecognized reasoning limit?
detail.reason: Attention constraints and capability blocks require parking this project to clear space and prioritize permitted topics.

detail.title: Identifying Unrecognized Reasoning Limits
detail.question: How can autonomous systems detect and analyze reasoning limitations that were not identified by their designers?
detail.reason: Attention rules require parking projects in capability-blocked domains.
